introHtml: Bella Canvas jackets offer a modern, lightweight feel that your team will actually want to wear. Unlike heavier workwear, these jackets feature a soft cotton-poly blend that drapes well and holds screen printing or embroidery cleanly. Ideal for trade shows, uniform programs, or employee gifts, they combine comfort with a polished look that represents your brand well. Choose from full-zip or pullover styles in versatile colors.
